Name: BigDumbYak's Home Spa. A Personal Spa Building for Your Farm
Author: BigDumbYak
Description:
[b][size=4]Overview
[/size][/b]Bring a touch of calm to your farm with the Home Spa, a custom building designed to give your farmer a convenient place to rest,
recover, and recharge. This mod adds a cozy, lore‑friendly spa interior featuring a heated pool, a relaxing sauna, and adjustable ambience — all integrated cleanly into Stardew’s progression.

Whether you want a quick stamina top‑up during busy days or a role‑play space for your farmer’s self‑care routine, the Home Spa blends seamlessly into the game’s world.
 
[b]Features[/b]

NEW FEATURES in 1.2.15
•            Bugfix for dll failing to load if GMCM is not installed.  Now works with or without GMCM.
•            Added new translations

1.2.11[/size]
[size=2]•            Building works on any Farm or other buildable location now.
•            Fixed weird variable token issue.
•            Brazillian Portugese translation by [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/59340891-maatsuki/]Maatsuki[/url]﻿!
[/size]
[size=3] 1.2.8[/size]
[size=2]•            Seasonal variants available with additional mod (See link below)
•            GMCM Option for setting custom date of Robin's letter Delivery
•            Added regional language support! Espanol and Francais added.
[/size]
[b][size=3]Restorative Pool[/size][/b]
•            Works just like the vanilla spa pool
•            Restores Health and Stamina while you soak
•            Seasonal variants available with additional mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41794]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41794
[/url]
[b][size=3]Custom Sauna With Adjustable Buffs[/size][/b]
•            Grants a Max Stamina buff while you sit inside. The longer you stay, the higher the buff
•            Default buff: +15% Max Stamina
•            All buff settings are fully configurable through GMCM, including:
•            Buff Maximum
•            Buff accumulation speed
•            Option to disable the buff entirely

[b][size=3]Adjustable Ambience[/size][/b]
•            Visual and audio effects can be customized in GMCM
•            Tailor the spa’s atmosphere to your preferred level of immersion

[b][size=3]Lore‑Friendly Unlock[/size][/b]
•            Robin will send you a letter letting you know when she has the blueprints ready. This happens 2 days after the vanilla spa becomes available.
•            Build the Home Spa through Robin. Construction takes 2 days.
•            Custom Cutscene with Robin and your highest ranked single NPC upon completion
 
[b][size=3]GMCM Support[/size][/b]
•            All major features are configurable
•            Easy to tweak for balance, accessibility, or personal preference
•            Adjustable date for Robin’s Letter and toggle for "Letter received" if you want to trigger that again.

[b][size=3]Requirements[/size][/b]
•            SMAPI
•            Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) (Optional)
•            Content Patcher (for the Home Spa Seasonal Pack)
[b][size=3]
Future Plans
[/size][/b]•            Decoratable Interior. Furniture and paintings placement, etc.
•            Additional spa themes
•            Expanded relaxation features
•            Additional translations from active translator/mod authors (contact me if interested)
